queries.title: Trace status totals
queries.question: How many task attempts are in scope, and how many ended in success, error, or another state?
queries.oracle: Count traces by normalized status.

queries.title: Longest task attempt
queries.question: Which task attempt took the longest, including all deterministic ties?
queries.oracle: Find the maximum duration and return every tied trace.

queries.title: Token usage by trace
queries.question: Report input, output, and cache-read tokens for each trace and identify the largest input-plus-output total.
queries.oracle: Normalize missing usage fields, calculate totals, and resolve ties.

queries.title: Generation count and P95 latency
queries.question: For each trace, how many generations were recorded and what is the nearest-rank P95 generation duration?
queries.oracle: Join generations to traces and apply the declared nearest-rank definition.

queries.title: Final output availability
queries.question: Which traces contain a nonblank final output and what is its Unicode character length?
queries.oracle: Apply the declared blank-string and Unicode-length rules.

queries.title: Latest attempt per session
queries.question: What is the latest recorded task attempt in each session?
queries.oracle: Group by session and select the latest end time with deterministic ties.

queries.title: Session execution timeline
queries.question: Build the ordered attempt timeline for every session.
queries.oracle: Join sessions and traces and order by time and stable identifier.

queries.title: Notebook version lineage
queries.question: Which hourly_h3_analysis notebook versions are mentioned in each trace input, output, or observation preview?
queries.oracle: Search declared text fields with the hourly_h3_analysis version pattern.

queries.title: Canonical data quality audit
queries.question: Audit counts, required fields, root observations, parent links, and timestamp ordering.
queries.oracle: Check foreign keys, roots, required values, and interval ordering.

queries.title: Task-to-answer lineage reconstruction
queries.question: For every model answer, reconstruct task, model, session, trace, root observation, and grading lineage; report orphaned, duplicated, or ambiguous links.
queries.oracle: Join the full hierarchy and validate one-to-one and one-to-many cardinality rules.

queries.title: Failed attempt details
queries.question: Which task attempts failed and what error, duration, turn, session, and tool count were recorded?
queries.oracle: Filter normalized error traces and return declared fields.

queries.title: Tool usage summary
queries.question: How many successful and failed calls were recorded for each tool name?
queries.oracle: Normalize tool names and count by tool and status.

queries.title: Failed tool calls
queries.question: Which individual tool calls failed and where did they occur?
queries.oracle: Filter error tool observations and preserve trace and order identifiers.

queries.title: Slowest tool calls
queries.question: What are the five slowest tool calls, using the declared tie and ordering rules?
queries.oracle: Calculate durations and apply deterministic top-k ordering.

queries.title: Later success after failure
queries.question: For each failed trace, was there a strictly later successful trace in the same session, and what was the time gap?
queries.oracle: Search later attempts in the same session and distinguish temporal succession from proven retry lineage.

queries.title: Success-versus-error profiles
queries.question: Compare successful and failed attempts by duration, tool count, and token usage without claiming significance.
queries.oracle: Calculate declared descriptive summaries by status.

queries.title: Paired model accuracy
queries.question: On tasks attempted by both selected models, what is each accuracy, the paired difference, discordant-pair table, exact McNemar p-value, and confidence interval?
queries.oracle: Build a matched task cohort and run an exact paired binary comparison.

queries.title: Paired model latency
queries.question: On matched successful tasks, what is the median paired latency difference and its seeded bootstrap 95% confidence interval?
queries.oracle: Pair by task and repeat, calculate medians, and bootstrap pairs with a fixed seed.

queries.title: Quality-cost Pareto frontier
queries.question: Which models are Pareto-efficient when accuracy is maximized and median cost and latency are minimized?
queries.oracle: Calculate matched metrics and apply strict Pareto dominance rules.

queries.title: Model-by-difficulty interaction
queries.question: Does the accuracy gap between two models change from easy to hard tasks, and what is the bootstrap interval for that change?
queries.oracle: Calculate matched difficulty-stratum differences and a seeded cluster bootstrap interval.

queries.title: Trace complexity and correctness
queries.question: What is the Spearman association between trace complexity and answer correctness, and is it stable under a task-level permutation test?
queries.oracle: Create a declared complexity index, calculate Spearman rho, and permute within the valid task structure.

queries.title: Tool failure and task failure
queries.question: How strongly is any tool failure associated with final task failure? Report the 2x2 table, risk ratio, confidence interval, and Fisher exact p-value.
queries.oracle: Derive exposure per trace and calculate exact and effect-size statistics with declared zero-cell handling.

queries.title: Retry count and recovery
queries.question: Does recovery probability change monotonically across retry-count levels after controlling the analysis unit at the original failure?
queries.oracle: Construct one row per original failure and apply a declared ordered trend test with stratum summaries.
queries.answer_shape: recovery rates, trend statistic, and warnings

queries.title: Failure concentration by tool
queries.question: Are tool failures broadly distributed or concentrated in a few tools? Report shares, HHI, Gini coefficient, and seeded bootstrap intervals.
queries.oracle: Aggregate failures by normalized tool and calculate concentration measures with fixed resampling.

queries.title: Performance drift and change point
queries.question: Is there evidence of a time change in success rate or latency after accounting for minimum window size and multiple testing?
queries.oracle: Evaluate eligible split points, apply the declared test and correction, and return effect sizes and the selected point.
queries.answer_shape: window metrics and corrected change-point result

queries.title: Annotation validity audit
queries.question: Which annotations violate the JSON schema, target relationship, annotator identity, or timestamp rules?
queries.oracle: Validate versioned JSON labels, foreign keys, identities, and labeled-versus-ingested timestamps.
queries.answer_shape: invalid annotation rows and reason counts

queries.title: Effective-label reconstruction
queries.question: What is the current effective label for each target after following superseded and retracted annotation history?
queries.oracle: Resolve immutable revision chains, detect cycles and branches, and return the unique active head.

queries.title: Inter-annotator agreement
queries.question: For shared targets, what are raw agreement and chance-corrected agreement by label and task category?
queries.oracle: Select comparable effective labels and calculate Cohen or Fleiss kappa with prevalence summaries.

queries.title: Annotator bias on shared items
queries.question: On targets labeled by the same annotator pairs, do positive-label rates differ systematically?
queries.oracle: Build matched shared-item cohorts and run paired comparisons with multiplicity correction.

queries.title: Revision and ingestion delay
queries.question: How often do labels change, which transitions occur, and how long elapses from labeling to ingestion and from one revision to the next?
queries.oracle: Order valid revision chains and calculate transition counts and latency distributions.
